thread:
anya: FYI — detected KMS decrypt by svc-ingest@cust-a in project proj-b (cross-org). Looks like a role binding with roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter exists on project/proj-b for serviceAccount:svc-ingest@cust-a. Raising triage.

sec-bot: ALERT: kAudit | UnusualCrossOrgKMSDecrypt detected for svc-ingest@cust-a at 2024-11-03T14:12:08Z. See /alerts/KA-4721

matt: omg. which binding? can someone paste the iam binding JSON?

anya: snippet from audit logs:
```
protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
resourceName: "projects/proj-b/locations/global/keyRings/ring-01/cryptoKeys/key-xyz"
authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "svc-ingest@cust-a.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

olivia: did we run the RBAC refactor that flattened org->project role inheritance last week? might have accidentally exported a binding.

devon: yes, refactor deployed 2024-11-01 03:10 UTC. I added migration that copied org-level groups down as project-level bindings for backwards compat. I'll inspect the migration logs.

matt: until we confirm, can we revoke the binding on proj-b? prefer a least-priv step.

anya: doing temporary revoke now: `rctl iam revoke --resource projects/proj-b --member svc-ingest@cust-a --role roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` will push in 2m

sec-bot: ACTION: revoke executed by anya at 2024-11-03T14:20:31Z — audit id ar-7729

devon: found migration line that matches: `migrateBindings()` applied group 'platform-read' -> copied to project proj-b due to missing org deny. Looks like svc-ingest was in that group by accident.

olivia: root cause: group membership sync included customer service accounts when it should've filtered by domain. Fixing filter and preparing a hotfix PR.

matt: KMS key exposure risk: rotate key-xyz, start key version disable, create new key and re-encrypt. Ops, can you handle the key rotation? This is high risk.

anya: I've submitted rotation request to ops-runbook: RB-2314. Added customer notification draft.

devon: PR created: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4201 — adds domain-only membership filter; also a migration rollback script.

olivia: also add an automated check in CI that flags cross-org serviceAccount bindings for cryptokeys.

matt: agree. add audit rule and alerting, and a postmortem. Owners: devon, anya

anya: postmortem scheduled, will include timeline and mitigation steps. closing triage for now. :white_check_mark:
